integrity: A full proof and ordinary finite reproducibility checker are supplied; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Integral H3 is proved to be an extension of C3 by C3, but its isomorphism type is not determined. The theorem concerns the ordinary geometric quotient for n=9 only. Prior-literature coverage is limited to inspected available sources.
title: Order-nine torsion and an exceptional fundamental group in the nine-gon associahedral rotation quotient
